title.narrative: UNODA: Advancing biosecurity and biology for peaceful purposes

description.narrative:
The project supports activities implemented in accordance with Article X of the Biological Weapons Convention: - Fellowship in Biological Science for Peaceful Purposes and Biosecurity - Training course on pathogen detection and Biosecurity - Training course on data science for effective outbreak response - Training in microbial genomics and bioforensics
The planned effect on society (Impact) is: Enhanced capacity of laboratories from the beneficiary developing countries to harness and leverage the benefits of biological sciences and technology for peaceful purposes and biosecurity, in accordance with Articles III and X of the BWC.
The planned effects for the target group of the Project (Outcome) are: Enhanced skills, knowledge, and awareness of experts from beneficiary countries on peaceful uses of biology and biosecurity.
The main planned outputs of the Project (Outputs) are: • Knowledge and skills in biological science for peaceful purposes and biosecurity enhanced. • Scientific and technological information exchange for the use of bacteriological (biological) agents and toxins for peaceful purposes promoted. • Information and project knowledge management promoted.
The Biological Weapons Convention Implementation Support Unit (BWC-ISU) is a sub-unit housed within the Geneva Branch of the United Nations Office for Disarmament Affairs (UNODA).
